origin.origins_apocalypse.razas/humano.d: An ordinary human doesn't change a thing, you idiot.
origin.origins_apocalypse.razas/alien.de: Beings from another planet, when they came to explore ours out of curiosity, were knocked out by gravity.
power.origins_apocalypse.alien/size_alie: Our planet's gravity has left you short; you're now 1 block tall.
origin.origins_apocalypse.razas/elfo.des: An incredibly long-lived breed, it can live for centuries.
Your longevity makes you taller. You are 1.5 blocks tall.
origin.origins_apocalypse.razas/orco.des: Not very smart, green, and grumpy beings.
A huge mole: 3 high and 2 wide.
origin.origins_apocalypse.razas/enano.de: A race almost as long-lived as elves.
power.origins_apocalypse.enano/size_enan: Short, but of broad and robust build.
origin.origins_apocalypse.clases/supervi: You have survived, although you don't quite know how.
origin.origins_apocalypse.clases/titan.d: A mountain of muscle and brute force. Impossible to ignore.
power.origins_apocalypse.titan/titan_fur: The more wounded you are, the stronger you become: you gain Strength and Resistance below 75%, 50% and 25% health.
power.origins_apocalypse.titan/titan_pun: Your bare-handed punches deal as much damage as a stone sword.
power.origins_apocalypse.titan/titan_ham: Your massive body burns through food faster.
origin.origins_apocalypse.clases/quimera: The result of an experiment that should never have survived... and yet, here it is.
power.origins_apocalypse.quimera/quimera: You can glide, but in a way that makes you take less fall damage.
You see in the dark like a champion.
Every day you live, a chicken hatches from you. Wings weren't the only thing you had in common with a hen >:D
origin.origins_apocalypse.clases/cerebri: No strength, but something far more dangerous: they know exactly what they're doing.
power.origins_apocalypse.cerebrito/cereb: Your body is weak, so you have 2 fewer hearts.
origin.origins_apocalypse.clases/corromp: Between the living and the dead. They belong to neither side anymore.
power.origins_apocalypse.corrompido/corr: A bar that slowly fills on its own. At 25% you gain Speed III, at 50% Night vision and at 75% Resistance III. If it fills completely, poison leaves you one step from death. Resets on death.
power.origins_apocalypse.corrompido/carr: You eat rotten flesh without suffering its effects.
origin.origins_apocalypse.clases/cypollo: Enhanced soldiers with implants, you are 50% human and 50% machine.
power.origins_apocalypse.cypollorg/cypol: Water damages your circuits: it harms you while you're in it.
